text: Is any part of a real human person still visible where the cartoon character should be (a real face, real hands, real skin at the edge of the character)?
Is there a visible white or light outline (a sticker halo) around the cartoon character?
Does the cartoon character look like it is floating above the ground, with no contact shadow under its feet?
Is there an obvious rendering glitch: a hard seam, a smear, a stretched texture, or a missing part?
Does the cartoon character look clearly different from the reference model sheet (wrong colours, wrong proportions, thinner or taller, missing features)?
